business_problem: ALPHAWAVE needed to scale high-quality generative video and AI automation services with a small team, which required early access to frontier models and a platform that could support both media production and internal task automation.
solution_summary: ALPHAWAVE uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: ALPHAWAVE needed to scale high-quality generative video and AI automation services with a small team, which required early access to frontier models and a platform that could support both media production and internal task automation. Vertex AI provides the infrastructure foundation for ALPHAWAVE’s proprietary AI agents and generative AI delivery workflows, serving as the compute layer. Veo generates photorealistic product and campaign video content at much lower cost and time than CGI-heavy workflows, serving as the compute layer. Flow supports rapid production of AI-native video content alongside Veo, serving as the serving layer. Campaign concepts and client requirements move into Vertex AI-based workflows, Veo and Flow generate the video outputs, and ALPHAWAVE’s proprietary agents automate supporting browser-based tasks such as reporting and format scaling.
